text:
Ellen: Heads-up: starting a short decompaction pass for admin entitlements today. Goal: trim redundant admin roles + capture KMS grant trails for compliance. 5-day window.
Marcus: 👍 scope? production-heavy roles only?
Ellen: prod first (console/API last-use > 90d OR no owner tag), then staging. svcaccts included. We'll treat human accounts more conservatively.
Ravi: KMS gotcha: roles may appear as grantees on key grants. we need an immutable snapshot before touching anything. Suggest sequence: 1) snapshot grants -> 2) tag role freeze -> 3) notify -> 4) wait 72h -> 5) remediate svcacct.
Hannah: Commands i'll run for snapshots: `aws kms list-grants --key-id $K --query \"Grants[?GranteePrincipal=='arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/$ROLE']\" --output json > /tmp/$ROLE-$K-grants.json` then `aws s3 cp /tmp/$ROLE-$K-grants.json s3://sec-logs/entitlement-decompaction/$ROLE/`
SecAuditBot: Created ticket SEC-472 and attached initial iam-diff + cloudtrail slice. Evidence bucket: s3://sec-logs/entitlement-decompaction/SEC-472/
Marcus: We should capture vault bindings and k8s rolebindings as well. I have `./tools/find_bindings --role $ROLE` that merges across Vault/k8s/GCP.
Ravi: Also add a quick check for assume-role external principals so we don't remove crossacct roles without checking downstream usage. `./tools/check_assume_paths $ROLE`
Ellen: Draft playbook (short):
```
./tools/ownerless_list --days 90 > candidates.txt
for r in $(cat candidates.txt); do
  tag: aws iam tag-role --role-name $r --tags Key=decompaction,Value=pending
  KLIST=$(./tools/list_keys_for_role $r)
  for K in $KLIST; do
    aws kms list-grants --key-id $K --query "Grants[?GranteePrincipal=='arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/$r']" --output json > /tmp/$r-$K-grants.json
    aws s3 cp /tmp/$r-$K-grants.json s3://sec-logs/entitlement-decompaction/SEC-472/
  done
  ./tools/find_bindings --role $r > /tmp/$r-bindings.txt
  notify owner (ownership-template) with cloudtrail slice + s3 links
done
```
Hannah: Notification window = 72h. svcacct with no response -> auto-remediate (revoke inline policies + detach non-essential managed policies). Human accounts -> manager approval required before removal.
KeyKeeper: Keys tagged `compliance:prod=true` must not be altered without KeyOps signoff. KeyOps SLA for signoff = 48h. We'll flag those keys in SEC-472.
SecAuditBot: SEC-472 evidence manifest uploaded: grants_index.csv, notify_log.txt.
Marcus: Escalation flow for contested removals?
Ellen: contested -> ping #eng-security oncall and OpsLead. 24h hold, after which SecLead+OpsLead must sign off to proceed. Document approval in ticket.
Ravi: Implementation note: prefer `RevokeGrant` API to dropping role bindings; record the API body and response JSON in the artifact store.
Hannah: I'll add a small script to redact any customer-identifying fields from cloudtrail slices before upload per legal guidance.
OpsLead: For private clusters, ops will require manual handback checklist. include runbook link: https://internal.runbooks/entitlements/handback-checklist
Ellen: Thanks. I'll post the ownership-notify template and a quick how-to for evidence uploads. Run the finder and flag false positives in-thread. :white_check_mark:
Marcus: Starting infra + kube pass now.
Ravi: Will run assume-path checks and list_keys_for_role.
Hannah: kicking off grant snapshots and uploads.
SecAuditBot: Thread noted in SEC-472. Add artifacts as they arrive.
Ellen: mid-sprint check-in in #eng-security in 2 days. End thread.
